label: Solana Privacy and Identity Management
summary: This cluster focuses on enhancing security and anonymity on the Solana blockchain through decentralized identity verification, private DeFi protocols, and zero-knowledge data storage.

representativeProjects.name: SolPass
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A decentralized password manager on Solana providing secure, private, and self-custodial credential storage.

representativeProjects.name: Zkyc
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Privacy-preserving KYC platform using zero-knowledge proofs on Solana for secure, one-time identity verification.

representativeProjects.name: VeilVault
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Privacy-first RWA fractionalization protocol using ZK-proofs for anonymous trading and selective disclosure.

representativeProjects.name: Encifher
representativeProjects.oneLiner: A privacy layer for Solana DeFi enabling encrypted on-chain actions and strategy execution without revealing alpha.

representativeProjects.name: Solana ID
representativeProjects.oneLiner: Decentralized identity platform linking digital footprints to wallets for personalized rewards and seamless logins.
